pre_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins" "${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins"; do [ -n "$d" ] || continue; for f in "$d/hooks/guard_hook.py" "$d"/*/hooks/guard_hook.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; done; done; python3 -c "import datetime,json,os;log=os.environ.get('OPENHARNESS_GUARD_AUDIT_LOG') or os.path.join(os.environ.get('OPENHARNESS_LOGS_DIR') or os.path.expanduser('~/.openharness/logs'),'guard-audit.jsonl');os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(log),exist_ok=True);open(log,'a',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps({'ts':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'hook':'pre_tool_use','event':'hook-missing','strict':os.environ.get('OPENHARNESS_GUARD_STRICT')=='1','cwd':os.getcwd()},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')" 2>/dev/null || true; if [ "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_STRICT:-0}" = "1" ]; then echo "[guard][BLOCKED] 未找到 guard_hook.py：strict 模式已拒绝本次工具调用。已查找：${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-(未设置)}、${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins、${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins、$PWD/.openharness/plugins。请修复安装或设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT，或临时 unset OPENHARNESS_GUARD_STRICT。" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "[guard][WARN] 未找到 guard_hook.py：本次工具调用未经任何拦截（fail-open）。已查找：${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-(未设置)}、${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins、${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins、$PWD/.openharness/plugins。请检查安装或设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT。" >&2; exit 0

post_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins" "${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins"; do [ -n "$d" ] || continue; for f in "$d/hooks/guard_audit.py" "$d"/*/hooks/guard_audit.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; done; done; python3 -c "import datetime,json,os;log=os.environ.get('OPENHARNESS_GUARD_AUDIT_LOG') or os.path.join(os.environ.get('OPENHARNESS_LOGS_DIR') or os.path.expanduser('~/.openharness/logs'),'guard-audit.jsonl');os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(log),exist_ok=True);open(log,'a',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps({'ts':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'hook':'post_tool_use','event':'hook-missing','strict':False,'cwd':os.getcwd()},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "[guard][WARN] 未找到 guard_audit.py：本次调用未被审计（fail-open）。已查找：${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-(未设置)}、${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins、${OHMO_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/.ohmo}/plugins、$PWD/.openharness/plugins。请检查安装或设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT。" >&2; exit 0
